name: Zherebtsov
desc: An angler from the Snezhnaya Fishing Association. He likens fishing to life, believing that the most important part of the experience is the journey and that carelessness can ruin it.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Gotta focus... Fishing, like life, can be ruined by a single moment of carelessness...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I'd like to buy some fishing supplies...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Oh, of course. It's important to be well-prepared when fishing... just as in life... Hehe...
(Opens Shop)
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: And have you won today?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> ...Only focusing on the win won't get you over the finish line. And that's a terribly narrow way to measure life, wouldn't you say?
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Just look at me... I've lost an avenue of honest work and my wife's tender loving care, but I've won it all back in the tranquility that fishing brings me...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: How about finding work?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Hehe... Harder than it looks nowadays! And who'd sell you fishing supplies if I were to pack it up and go?
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> It's not like I'm starving and destitute. We'll get by somehow. Fishing is about the fishing, not the fish, and life is about living, not just existing...
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Err, what I mean to say is that both fish and life are better well-done.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Uh... Okay?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Absolutely... Sure would be nice if I got a bite, though.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: If you'll excuse me, then...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Zherebtsov:</color> Oh, it's no problem at all. It's not as if the fish are swarming to my line or anything...

customize.name: Scepter of the Snow Angler King
customize.desc:
If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, using this rod will steadily shorten the time fish struggle and increase your chances of success. Only effective in Snezhnaya.

A fishing rod made from Prime Ice by an unknown artisan, acclaimed as "the scepter of the king of anglers in the land of snow." It is currently entrusted to the Snezhnaya Fishing Association. It is said that only anglers of supreme skill, fully tempered by the howling wind and snow, are worthy of wielding this rod...

customize.name: Fishing Line Stabilizer
customize.desc:
A self-adaptive tension stabilizer that can be installed on a fishing rod to facilitate fishing. The device can automatically detect and record how hard different fish struggle. The more data it collects, the better the stabilizer works.

The device's prototype was the pointless invention of a Fontaine inventor that drew little interest for the longest time until the Fontaine Fishing Association discovered it and modified the product into the fishing line stabilizer used today. When the device first came out, it was most warmly received by the Association members, and now it has gradually been promoted in other regions.

It is an exceptionally hot commodity in the Snezhnayan market. Word has it that one of the Lord Harbingers is particularly fond of the product, which explains the hype.
